tools.title: French company default risk score
tools.description: Company default-risk score (0-100) for a French company at ~12 months — credit risk and insolvency risk scoring from filed financial ratios (structure, profitability, liquidity, net cash, debt service, trend) + company age + a hard BODACC override (active insolvency / liquidation / closure for insufficiency of assets = proven default). These are OBSERVED rates on a sample, never a probability of default for the company you are reading; `versions_couvertes` names the scale versions the measurement holds for. tools.description: Use when asked to rank customers or suppliers by default risk, e.g. "Rank my customers by risk and monitor the 30 most exposed." tools.name: get_european_company_profile
tools.title: European company profile
tools.description: European company registry lookup: unified European company profile by country and national register ID, same JSON schema for every country (identity, legal form, normalized status, head office, VAT, LEI, official register link). National registers from local copies: Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, Romania, Sweden; live: Czechia, Finland, Poland, Slovakia, Switzerland; Denmark and the United Kingdom live through this profile; elsewhere via GLEIF (LEI). Poland (KRS): the status reads the proceedings entered in the register extract (bankruptcy, liquidation, restructuring, suspended activity: autre, the procedure in Polish and its date in statut_detail, e.g. upadłość 2024-12-19) and the strike-off (cesse, wykreślenie and its date); a proceeding not yet entered in the register is not seen. Country blocks: Belgium, NACEBEL activities and establishment units; Croatia, registre_hr; Cyprus, registre_cy (type, sub-type, dated register status family, registered office, mandates count; HE/AE numbers, legal persons only); Estonia, registre_ee and gages_commerciaux; Finland, registres_fi; Ireland, registre_ie; Latvia, succursale_etrangere; Lithuania, registre_lt and fiscalite_lt (capital, VAT, filing compliance, shareholder headcounts, tax arrears); Norway, unites_locales; Romania, registre_ro (every registration of the CUI, status codes in closed families, registered office, EU branches, mandates count; legal persons only). Croatia, Czechia, Estonia, Norway, Latvia and Slovakia serve legal persons only, and Belgium its whitelist of forms with legal personality: a Belgian entity without legal form or of a form without legal personality, a Croatian sole trader (trgovac pojedinac) or undecided form, a sole trader's IČO, an Estonian sole proprietorship (FIE), a Norwegian sole proprietorship (ENK), registered individual (PERS, TVAM) or estate (KBO, BO), a Latvian individual merchant (IK) or individual, family, farm or fishery enterprise, or a form not recognised as a legal person returns 404, not billed. A Swiss sole proprietorship (Einzelunternehmen), a Swiss branch whose head office is not served or an undecided legal form returns 404 as well, not billed. So do, in Denmark (CVR), a sole proprietorship (ENK), a personally owned small business (PMV), an estate (DØD) or an undecided CVR form; in Lithuania, an individual enterprise (individuali įmonė, IĮ), its branch (individualios įmonės filialas) or representative office (individualios įmonės atstovybė), or an undecided form; in Sweden, a sole proprietorship (enskild näringsverksamhet) or an undecided form; in Romania, an authorised natural person or an individual or family enterprise (PFA, II, IF, PF, AF), never loaded, or an undecided form; and, in Finland, Ireland, Poland and the United Kingdom, a form outside the register's published nomenclature (a foreign trader's branch included). Through GLEIF, a LEI that GLEIF flags as a natural person (sole proprietor category or natural-person legal form) or of an ambiguous legal form returns 404, not billed, the same way; a LEI without ELF code is judged by its written legal form (never served), and a LEI requested under another country than its own (its jurisdiction; for a branch, its legal address) returns 404 pays_ne_correspond_pas, not billed (never served under DE or NL). For LEI holders the profile carries groupe_lei: the GLEIF level-2 group, that is the direct and ultimate CONSOLIDATING parents (named, except a parent that GLEIF flags as a natural person or of an ambiguous legal form: mere_omise gives the reason, no name, no LEI; non_servie, a neutral value, when another reason leaves it out) or the declared reason for having none (accounting consolidation, never capital ownership or beneficial owners; sans_objet without a LEI). Belgian, Croatian, Cypriot, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Romanian, Swedish and Swiss profiles also carry financements_ue: Horizon 2020 / Horizon Europe projects from CORDIS matched by the published VAT number (sans_objet elsewhere). No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons explained by GET /v1/lecture); never read it as a low score. tools.name: validate_eu_vat_number
tools.title: Validate EU VAT number (VIES)
tools.description: VAT number check against VIES: use when you only need the tax half of verifying a supplier before payment: confirm that a counterparty's intra-community VAT number really exists before invoicing it, applying the reverse charge or paying it. It is a required check under the French e-invoicing mandate of 1 September 2026 and under the Belgian B2B mandate in force since 1 January 2026. Validates any EU intra-community VAT number against the official VIES service (all member states) and returns valid / invalid / unavailable, the registered name and address when the member state publishes them, and the VIES consultation identifier as proof. Name and address are served only for a holder that its number's format or its country's register (BE, PL, LV, HR, RO, SE, CZ, DK, FI, FR) proves a legal person; any other holder (natural person, undecided form, missing from its register, or in a state where no register qualifies it: AT, CY, DE, EE, EL, HU, IE, IT, LT, LU, MT, NL, SI, SK, XI) gets neither, the omission counted in ecartes by reason. A member-state outage is reported as unavailable, never as a false invalid. The response is Ed25519-signed and carries provenance[]: the VIES entry with the date the number was really consulted, never a fabricated one. Paid via x402 ($0.003 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
